cohort: The study included 60 cases aged 18-35 years with normal singleton gestation beyond 36 weeks, ASA II physical status, posted for elective caesarean sections under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Maternal blood pressure was maintained well with both ephedrine and phenylephrine, but phenylephrine was associated with a higher prevalence of bradycardia and nausea, with no significant differences in neonatal APGAR score or umbilical vein ABG between groups.
